desc:
👻 HALLOWEEN EVENT ACTIVE! 🦑

🌊 Welcome to DEVOUR.🦈
A realistic ocean survival game!
Start small, hunt for food, and evolve into the ocean’s most dangerous creatures.

🐟 Eat to grow with NO size limit!
🦈 Unlock stronger predators!
⚔️ Fight other players and climb the food chain!
🌊 Explore the reef, open ocean, or THE DEEP if you dare..
👑 Become the apex predator!

In THIS ocean, every animal is either THE HUNTER, or THE HUNTED..

⭐ Favorite the game for updates!
👍 Like the game for new creatures!

Devour is a multiplayer fish survival game where you eat smaller fish, grow bigger, evolve into sharks and prehistoric sea creatures, and dominate the ocean!
